dispatch.how: A dispatch is a GitHub issue spec routed via the orchestration surfaces to a provider lane; the provider authors a monorepo PR naming provider + session id; sub-manager verifies (provenance first); desk tracks merge on merge-clear and artifact sync. This page mutates nothing. Instance stamp is part of the dispatch record (DoE configured-instance identity, PR #2656): every dispatch carries provider + session_id + model@version verbatim + system_prompt_ref + tools_ref (ref scheme: repo path or prompt:<moniker>:<slug> / tools:<moniker>:<slug>, always with the SHA-256 of the exact dispatched content; compact stamp <ref>#<sha256[:12]>; instance_key via scripts/doe/instance_key.py). No stamp => no dispatch (telemetry gate, 2026-10-30 23:10 PT).

provider_catalog.note: COMPLETE catalog (owner order 2026-11-01, fix seat 5f3a3217): provider_lanes = every dispatch-capable surface in the Provider Index, honestly classed. Classes: proven = triggered and completed with cited evidence; wired-unproven = wired in-repo, no successful run yet (gets bounded proof dispatches, not production-critical work); triggerable = a live trigger exists (dispatch/schedule/event) but the surface is support-class or never fired; inference-only = registry model records reachable only through a named dispatch arm (provider-batch / provider-availability / openrouter probe) until a proof dispatch promotes them. CLASS CORRECTION (owner direct 2026-11-01, via manager): Qodo / Devin / CodeRabbit review + provider-command-dispatch = review/command surfaces, NOT wired inference providers — they do NOT count toward the batch; their results stand as their own class, reported separately. BATCH UNIVERSE = the inference bench (inference_only below: 91 model records / 89 distinct) with wired invoke routes (llm_map / provider routes); batch redirected there — ∀ triggerable inference providers fired at production builds, per-provider invoke outcomes reported. Invoke-route status at correction: provider-batch contracts RED (#2672; latest run 41303413675 failure 2026-11-01T11:47Z) — inference firing gated on contracts green (Swarm/quota/fix lanes own the fix; desk holds provider-batch dispatches per standing hold).

rotation_rule.rule: Bench-wide TASK-FIT rotation (owner FIX via main, 2026-11-01; supersedes the no-2-consecutive rule): every dispatch selects from the FULL wired bench in this catalog — the surface whose class fits the task (build / fix / review / device / probe / inference arm) — with no fixed funnel and no automatic repeat of the previous pick. Stamps carry provider + selection reason + bench position (the provider's catalog class).
rotation_rule.selection: Task-fit across the full catalog: (1) match task class to lanes; (2) proven lanes carry production work; (3) wired-unproven / triggerable surfaces receive bounded, DoE-stamped proof dispatches instead of permanent exile — a first success promotes them to proven at the next feed refresh; (4) inference-only registry providers are selectable for inference/eval tasks via their named dispatch arm, stamped with provider + model@version; (5) every dispatch stamps provider + surface + selection reason + session/run id (telemetry gate: no stamp => no dispatch).

compounding.rule: OWNER RULE (2026-11-01): every time a new endpoint is wired, it is eligible to join the process of continuing the wiring — wiring COMPOUNDS. A provider joins the wiring worker pool the moment its invoke wiring lands (code route + selection entry + evidence). Packages are sharded across the pool by task-fit; no single provider or vendor — including Google (Jules + Gemini) — is the default, sole, or consecutive builder. Each landed wiring PR must name the providers it unlocks into the pool.
compounding.mechanics: Pool members contribute through their wired invoke routes (generation / review / verification legs) and, where a repo build lane exists for them, build legs. Desk shards packages across the pool and stamps the shard's provider; Swarm second-pass reviews; fix seat republishes pool membership on every wiring landing.
